lowercase_keyword_review.text: Specific applications will frequently have a much simpler method of determining the keys to use, as there may be one or two key selection methods that are profiled for the application's use.
lowercase_keyword_review.note: lowercase per RFC 8174: not normative by itself, but review -- normative intent is often written without keywords

lowercase_keyword_review.text: Sources of keys may include:

lowercase_keyword_review.text: Conforming implementations must reject input containing critical extensions that are not understood or cannot be processed.
lowercase_keyword_review.note: lowercase per RFC 8174: not normative by itself, but review -- normative intent is often written without keywords

lowercase_keyword_review.text: The following JWS must be rejected by all implementations, because it uses an extension Header Parameter name "http://example.invalid/ UNDEFINED" that they do not understand.
lowercase_keyword_review.note: lowercase per RFC 8174: not normative by itself, but review -- normative intent is often written without keywords

lowercase_keyword_review.text: Any other similar input, in which the use of the value "http://example.invalid/UNDEFINED" is substituted for any other Header Parameter name not understood by the implementation, must also be rejected.
